description: Hung the plot, and refused to restore the cut.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Would rather hear the word than a story about the word.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Stood by the door, and was told the gown is the one he has.
name: Nick Sorrell

description: Kept the glass on the seat, and sent him home to count silver.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Broke on one word, said the line again, and did not ask about the glass.
name: William Shakespeare
